notes: 2025 proxy is a contested DEFC14A (0001759509-25-000069, filed 2025-04-24; Engine Capital also filed a DEFC14A); the 2025-05-23 DEFR14A (0001759509-25-000096) only withdraws Ariel Cohen's nomination and has no comp changes. There is no plain 'DEF 14A' for 2025.

TSR restatement: the 2023 proxy's PvP printed 2021 $86.97 and 2022 $25.79 (S&P 500 IT $133.35 / $71.09), which are one-year returns (42.73/49.13, 11.02/42.73), not cumulative from the stated 12/31/2019 base. The 2024 proxy shows the cumulative values for the same years: 2021 $99.33, 2022 $25.62 (S&P IT $189.64 / $134.82). The 2026 proxy moves the base to 12/31/2020, so its values ($86.97, $22.43, $30.51, $26.26, $39.43) differ from earlier tables by design.
PvP 2026 drops FY2020 and says Green was PEO for fiscal 2021-2023; SCT/CAP figures for overlapping years are identical across all four PvP tables (only TSR and peer TSR changed).

SCT figure revisions: McNeill FY2018 total was 32,420,826 in the S-1 (bonus 'not yet been determined'); the 424B4 and 2020 proxy report 32,840,826 incl. a $420,000 pro-rated 2018 bonus. No other (person, year) total changed across filings.

Roberts FY2021 stock_awards 6,404,964 = 2021 RSU grant-date value 6,895,989 plus net incremental fair value from the Dec 1, 2021 modification of his 2019-2021 RSUs (-302,925 + 436,154 - 624,254); separation cash $75,000 (8-K).

Sverchek FY2024 total 8,486,411 includes all_other 1,651,840: $1,608,010 severance (cash $1,137,500, COBRA $33,462, $437,048 ASC 718 charge for accelerated RSUs) plus $34,071 advisory fees. The 2025 SCT still prints her title as 'President' (CD&A: 'former President'). Her FY2022 total is only 539,338 (no equity grant in 2022).
Paul FY2023 and Raj FY2023 each include $340,966 severance (6 months salary $325,000 + COBRA). Paul FY2022 includes a $1,500,000 sign-on bonus and 14,707,974 new-hire RSUs.

Green/Zimmer FY2023: stock awards 260,005 each are RSUs under Founder Transition Agreements; all_other includes advisory+COBRA fees ($319,653 Green, $240,966 Zimmer) and salary includes director fees ($63,544 Green, $20,110 Zimmer).

Risher FY2023 78,238,027: 73,322,375 grant-date value of a 12,250,000-share stock-price PSU (sole equity award for the first four years; none expected until 2027) plus $4,250,000 bonus ($3,250,000 sign-on + $1,000,000 guaranteed 2023 bonus). His CAP swung from +135.4M (2023) to -41.1M (2024) to +37.0M (2025).
Co-founder personal security drives all_other: Zimmer $2,064,823 (2020), $1,569,567 (2019), $1,004,566 (2021); Green $935,105 (2018).
2021 'Bonus' column for Green/Zimmer/Sverchek/Roberts (32,712) and Raj (20,596) is a one-time payment of 105% of the 2020 COVID salary reduction.
Zimmer FY2018 (415,674) is reported only in the 2020/2021 proxies; he was not an S-1 NEO (S-1 NEOs were Green, Makavy, McNeill).

Tenure-date conflicts: Paul start Jan 3, 2022 (8-K) vs Jan 4, 2022 (2022 proxy, Form 3); Makavy CPO end announced Feb 28, 2020 (8-K) vs 'until March 2020' (proxy); Lipkovitz new title announced Feb 28, 2020 vs 'since March 2020' (bio) vs Form 3 2020-03-31; Raj Head of Rideshare 'since August 2021' vs Form 3 2021-10-26; Llewellyn CLO 'since July 2024' vs Form 3 2024-08-21; Sverchek GC/Secretary end Nov 1, 2021 (8-K) vs 'to October 2021' (bios).

Inclusion rule used for tenures: a title counts if it appears in a filing's executive-officer table or carries Section 16 officer status (Form 3). Borderline entries carry a 'flag' (Makavy pre-IPO EVP Rideshare Technology; Blackwood-Kapral CAO; Brewer interim CAO). Excluded: Raj interim Head of Rideshare, Llewellyn General Counsel and Secretary, Llewellyn interim Chief People Officer, Lipkovitz EVP Engineering, Roberts SVP Partnerships (Oct-Nov 2014), Makavy EVP Strategic Initiatives, Green Board Chair / Zimmer Vice Chair (board roles).
Brewer is retiring as CFO effective 2026-09-28 (8-K 0001628280-26-061020); Michael Brous succeeds her (Form 3 event 2026-09-28).
